vocals.source: anvuew vocal dereverb BS-RoFormer on MUSDB18-HQ train vocal stems, 20 s vocal-active excerpts
vocals.note: high_db is +4 dB, the 95th percentile of readings on 65 released tracks of all genres (E33); the MUSDB18-HQ p90 is -1.3. A vocal above it is reduced to 0 dB, the edge of the normal range, and no further. Readings above max_credible_db mean the stem is not a voice the meter understands.

mix_excess.source: ft_bs full-mix model on MUSDB18-HQ train mixtures, MIT IR Survey + synthetic reverb
